title: Yo-yo
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- String -->
  <path d='M50 8 Q48 20 50 30' stroke='#CCCCCC' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- String loop at top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='8' r='3' fill='none' stroke='#CCCCCC' stroke-width='2'/>
  
  <!-- Yo-yo body - outer left disc -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='60' rx='22' ry='28' fill='#E63946'/>
  <!-- Yo-yo body - outer right disc -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='60' rx='22' ry='28' fill='#E63946'/>
  
  <!-- Left disc inner rim -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='60' rx='16' ry='21' fill='#F4A261'/>
  <!-- Right disc inner rim -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='60' rx='16' ry='21' fill='#F4A261'/>
  
  <!-- Left disc highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='54' rx='7' ry='9' fill='#F9C784'/>
  <!-- Right disc highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='54' rx='7' ry='9' fill='#F9C784'/>
  
  <!-- Center axle -->
  <rect x='46' y='44' width='8' height='32' rx='3' fill='#2A9D8F'/>
  
  <!-- Center bolt / star decoration -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='7' fill='#2A9D8F'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='4' fill='#E9C46A'/>
  
  <!-- Star on left disc -->
  <polygon points='38,50 39.5,54 44,54.5 40.5,57.5 41.5,62 38,59.5 34.5,62 35.5,57.5 32,54.5 36.5,54' fill='#E9C46A'/>
  
  <!-- Star on right disc -->
  <polygon points='62,50 63.5,54 68,54.5 64.5,57.5 65.5,62 62,59.5 58.5,62 59.5,57.5 56,54.5 60.5,54' fill='#E9C46A'/>
  
  <!-- Left disc rim edge (lighter shade of red) -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='60' rx='22' ry='28' fill='none' stroke='#FF6B6B' stroke-width='2'/>
  
  <!-- Right disc rim edge -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='60' rx='22' ry='28' fill='none' stroke='#FF6B6B' stroke-width='2'/>
  
  <!-- Small decoration dots around left rim -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='52' r='2.5' fill='#E9C46A'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='68' r='2.5' fill='#E9C46A'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='52' r='2.5' fill='#E9C46A'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='68' r='2.5' fill='#E9C46A'/>
  
  <!-- String coming from center -->
  <line x1='50' y1='32' x2='50' y2='44' stroke='#CCCCCC' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
